prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail platinum silver hair — wearing a tight cropped sleeveless deep burgundy velvet zip-front top with a high collar, a chrome front zipper unzipped from the collar all the way down to her belly button where the chrome slider rests at her navel, the two zipper edges with their metal teeth running in a long deep V along her sternum and stomach, each side of the top covering one breast, paired with a deep burgundy velvet micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her midriff bare below the zipper. Her waist wears a silver chain waist harness of a fine chain around her waist and another around her hips, joined by several fine chains draped in a diagonal lattice over her stomach, a small silver chain tassel resting at her navel. Her left leg wears a sheer silver glitter thigh-high stocking with a wide lace top band, fine sparkling glitter scattered through the nylon, hugging her left thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her warm golden-brown skin faintly visible through the sheer nylon, matching the rest of her body. Her right leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her right calf and knee and ending high on her right thigh, running down into her heel. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of deep burgundy velvet, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy deep burgundy lacquer with a high polish.
Body glitter: fine gold shimmer dusted over her shoulders, collarbones and thighs, sparkling on the skin.
Jewelry: a black leather collar with a small silver ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a long fine silver chain falls diagonally across her torso and swings down to her left hip, ending in a small silver tassel that hangs at her hip, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a long silver chain ending in a heavy gold anvil-shaped weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a sunlit hanok courtyard with a pale earth floor, a standard-height wooden door, a low stone step and a waist-high clay wall, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
